# Angel Life Science

> > Angel Life Science provides evidence-based health information covering medical treatments, Ayurvedic medicine, diagnostic testing, and medical tourism across the United States and India.

The site bridges conventional Western medicine with traditional Ayurvedic practices, offering practical guidance on medications like GLP-1 receptor agonists (Ozempic, Semaglutide), comprehensive health screenings (CBC, metabolic panels), and healthcare decision-making for conditions ranging from diabetes to cancer. Content also addresses medical tourism considerations and herbal supplement safety.

## Key Topics

- GLP-1 receptor agonists (Ozempic, Semaglutide)
- Ayurveda and doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha)
- Complete Blood Count (CBC) and health screening
- Medical tourism (United States, India)
- Diabetes medication alternatives
- Herbal supplements and safety
- Cancer survival rates and palliative care
- Healthcare states (Florida, Texas, California)
- Bone healing and orthopedic surgery
- Travel medical insurance
- Type 2 diabetes treatment
- Turmeric and anti-inflammatory foods
- Dental implant procedures
- Heart surgery candidacy
- Long-term therapy effectiveness

- [Alternatives to Metformin: What Are Doctors Prescribing?](https://angellifescience.in/alternatives-to-metformin-what-are-doctors-prescribing): Type 2 diabetes alternatives: GLP-1 agonists, SGLT2, DPP-4 inhibitors
